faqs.q: How do I start working with Chapter as a buyer?
faqs.a: Contact us or book a free consultation. We'll match you with an agent who specializes in your target neighbourhoods and price range.
Our leasing-only service is one month's rent. Full management is 8–10% of monthly rent. Volume discounts apply for multi-unit portfolios.

faqs.q: How long does it take to find a tenant?
faqs.a: Typically 2–4 weeks from marketing launch, depending on property type and price. Our average vacancy is under 18 days.

faqs.q: Do you work with investors looking to buy income properties?
faqs.a: Yes — our investment team specializes in sourcing and evaluating income properties and off-market opportunities.

faqs.q: Can I transfer my license to Chapter?
faqs.a: Yes. We accept license transfers from other brokerages. Contact our recruitment team for a confidential conversation.
